radius_behaviour_how: Counted canonical objects where `ssot/<topic>/<topic>.json` exists, `search.strategy` is absent/false, and at least one `search.databases[]` dict has `date_executed`. That is 16/155 objects. Mapped those objects through `ssot/PAGE_MAP.json`, yielding 18/163 served page entries because azilsartan and bococizumab each have two mapped pages. Served-byte check found the current bad label in 18/18 affected pages.

kinds.classification_how: For each PAGE_MAP served page, classified root HTML as redirect if it contained refresh/window.location/moved-page redirect markers, tombstone if the title started `Retired --` or tombstone classes were present, otherwise live. All 18 affected served pages are live.

three_states: No search evidence held: no `search.strategy` and no dated executed `search.databases[]` limb; the existing `No systematic search was run` limitation may still be true.
Normalized search strategy held: `search.strategy` exists; do not emit either no-search or third-state limitation.

Executed database limbs held but no normalized strategy: at least one `search.databases[]` entry has `date_executed`; emit the third-state limitation instead of denying the search. This is the affected 16/155-object state.
marker: Dated database-search limbs are held; no normalized strategy field is held.
marker_absent_verified: Verified before writing this report with fixed-string grep via a temporary pattern file: `rg -n -F -f <temp-pattern-file> .` returned exit 1 and the wrapper printed `ABSENT 0 hits for 2 markers`. This marker had 0 hits anywhere under F:/fixwt/live at verification time.
obvious_fix: One-line version: change the condition to `if not (canon.get("search") or {}).get("strategy") and not (canon.get("search") or {}).get("databases"):` and leave the rest unchanged.
obvious_fix_would_fire: No for the affected set: tested over the 16 dated-database/no-strategy objects, and that one-line condition fired 0/16 because all 16 affected objects have nonempty `search.databases`. It would suppress the bad denial on 16/16, but it would not emit the required third-state served marker and would also treat undated database records as enough to suppress the old limitation.
notes: The slice's 16-object count is reproducible only when `executed` means a database limb with `date_executed`; a broader nonempty-database predicate returns 17/155 by including ARNI, whose database records lack `date_executed`. Checked frozen/excluded objects: gepotidacin and HFREF-like objects did not match this predicate. No edits made to `ssot/projectors.py`; proposed patch only.

three_states: No screening evidence held: no per-record `screening.records` and no aggregate `prisma_flow`/`k_cascade`; use the absent-state wording.
Aggregate screening counts held but row-level log absent: `prisma_flow` or `k_cascade` exists, while `screening.records` is empty; emit the third-state note. This is the affected 10/155-object state.
Per-record screening log held: `screening.records` is nonempty; let `screen_partial_note(body)` compute which count limbs are held/missing from the actual screen panel.
marker: Aggregate PRISMA counts are held; row-level screening decisions are absent.
marker_absent_verified: Verified before writing this report with fixed-string grep via a temporary pattern file: `rg -n -F -f <temp-pattern-file> .` returned exit 1 and the wrapper printed `ABSENT 0 hits for 2 markers`. This marker had 0 hits anywhere under F:/fixwt/live at verification time.
obvious_fix: One-line version: change `_carries_something` to also be true when `tid == "screen" and (canon.get("prisma_flow") or canon.get("k_cascade"))`, leaving the existing `screen_partial_note(body) or PARTIAL_STATE[tid]` note selection unchanged.
obvious_fix_would_fire: Yes, but incompletely: tested over the 10 aggregate-count/no-record objects, that one-line condition would fire for 10/10 because every affected object has `prisma_flow` or `k_cascade`. It would route them to the generic PARTIAL_STATE screen note, not the safer specific sentence that aggregate counts are in PRISMA/cascade while row-level screening decisions are absent.
